question: In which year was the first underground section (Vishwavidyalaya- Kashmere Gate) of the Golden Route opened in New Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2004**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first underground section (Vishwavidyalaya- Kashmere Gate) of the Golden Route in New Delhi was opened in the year **2004**.
 
• This section is part of the Delhi Metro, which is a rapid transit system serving Delhi and its satellite cities.
 
• The opening of this section marked a significant milestone in the development of the Delhi Metro network, facilitating efficient and quick transportation for commuters.
 
• The Delhi Metro has since expanded significantly and is considered one of the most successful metro systems in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) was established in 1995 to build and operate the Delhi Metro.
 
• Shri E. Sreedharan, also known as the "Metro Man," played a crucial role in the successful implementation of the Delhi Metro project.
 
• The Delhi Metro network is known for its punctuality, cleanliness, and efficient service, setting a benchmark for other metro projects in India.
 
• As of now, the Delhi Metro network spans over 300 kilometers, covering a large part of the National Capital Region (NCR).
